newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile shares close lower on foreign selling.
newsitem.headline: Chile shares close lower on foreign selling.

text.p: The Santiago Stock Exchange's IPSA blue-chip index closed down 0.81 percent at 96.35 on Thursday after heavy selling by foreign investors, traders said.
The IGPA general stocks index slipped 0.64 percent to 5,246.6. Volume traded was $22 million.
Traders said that local institutional investors were absent from the market, while foreigners sold.
